items.why: Moving with the AI bounce lifting stocks today, as coverage notes tech and AI plays bouncing ahead of Meta and Tesla earnings.
SpaceX shares are surging on Tesla deal talks, the day's big story, and Tesla is climbing on the same news flow with earnings ahead.
Riding the broader tech rally, with the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all gaining on earnings optimism and AI names bouncing.
Slipping as Alphabet opts out of tokenized stocks in what coverage calls a blow to the plan from OKK and the NYSE parent firm.

market_note: Futures steady into the close; VIX down as earnings cheer supports stocks.
summary: The Nasdaq is leading the tape higher near 1% as tech and AI plays bounce ahead of Meta and Tesla earnings. AI names are the biggest winners while Alphabet slips on the tokenized-stocks opt-out.
